title: Affine chart coherence on original elements
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative local ring and let $C$ be its maximal-ideal adic completion [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion], with structural homomorphism $\varphi:A\to C$. Let $U\subseteq\operatorname{Spec}A$ be open, $q:Y\to U$ and $s:E\to\operatorname{Spec}C$ morphisms of schemes, and $D$ a supplied overlap identification [def-sbc-punctured-completion-matching-sections]. Let $t\in\mathbb N$, $f:\operatorname{Fin}(t)\to A$, and suppose $D(f_i)\subseteq U$ and $V_i=(q\circ U.\iota)^{-1}D(f_i)$ is affine for every $i$. Put $O=Y\times_U(\operatorname{Spec}C|_U)$ and $p:O\to Y$ its projection. Suppose $T$ is any system of transition and section equivalences satisfying the scalar and restriction formulas [lem-sbc-punctured-completion-affine-chart-transitions], with no coherence hypothesis. The two square paths in [def-weil-pbc-formal-glueing-data], using $T$'s transition maps and the canonical comparison and swap, agree on $(m'/1)/1$ for every $m'\in M'$. The two cocycle paths agree on $(m/1)/1$ for every $m\in M_i$ and every triple $i,j,k$. This statement concerns only images of original elements, not arbitrary fractions, and constructs no modules or maps.

proof.text: every V_i is affine by hypothesis. First, b_right on the diagonal i=j and b_scalar show that c_i intertwines A-scalars with the structural action on Gamma(Y,V_i). The two b formulas identify alpha_ij on chart generators with restriction from V_i to V_i intersect V_j. Use b_scalar and the affine basic-open localization property to extend these identifications to fractions: b_ij(m/f_i^a) is the restriction of c_j(m) divided by the image of f_i^a. Localizing b_ij further at f_k identifies the iterated module with sections on V_i intersect V_j intersect V_k. The target section map is an equivalence, since this is a principal open in the affine double intersection. Under that equivalence the two cocycle routes take m to its restriction to the triple intersection. On a fraction (m/f_j^a)/f_k^b both routes divide that restriction by f_j^a f_k^b. The canonical swap exchanges these denominators. In particular, setting both denominators equal to one gives the asserted equality for each original chart element; the source restriction maps coincide by functoriality of the structure presheaf.

For square, localize d_j at f_i. Structural C-linearity d_scalar and d_chart identify the base change of alpha_ij on every pure tensor with restriction between the completed principal opens: z tensor (m/f_j^a) maps to z times the pullback restriction of c_i(m), divided by the image of f_j^a. This follows first at denominator one from naturality of p.app and b_left and b_right, then for all denominators because their structural actions are invertible on the appropriate open. Additivity extends it to every tensor. The comparison map sends (z tensor m)/1 to z tensor (m/1), and its fraction formula follows by the same uniqueness property. Now d_prime says both square routes on an original m' are restriction of D.toCompleted.appTop(e(m')) to the completed double intersection. On (m'/f_i^a)/f_j^b both divide that same section by f_i^a f_j^b. D.over ensures that the structural images of these denominators agree on the two sides. The localized d_j is an equivalence to sections there, so their images determine equality. Setting both denominators equal to one proves the asserted square equation on each original completed section. There is no flatness or covering assumption. Zero principal opens give zero modules and all identities hold there; with t=0 the clauses are vacuous.

lean.statement:
theorem affine_chart_transition_generator_coherence
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsLocalRing A]
    {U : (Spec (.of A)).Opens}
    {Y : Scheme.{u}} {q : Y ⟶ U.toScheme}
    {E : Scheme.{u}} {s : E ⟶ Spec
      (.of (AdicCompletion (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) A))}
    (D : CompletionGluingData A U q E s) (t : ℕ) (f : Fin t → A)
    (hf : ∀ i, PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (f i) ≤ U)
    (hV : ∀ i, IsAffineOpen ((q ≫ U.ι) ⁻¹ᵁ PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (f i)))
    (T : AffineChartTransitions D t f) :
    (∀ i j : Fin t,
      ∀ m : T.F.M',
      T.F.squareLeft i j (LocalizedModule.mk (LocalizedModule.mk m 1) 1) =
        T.F.squareRight i j (LocalizedModule.mk (LocalizedModule.mk m 1) 1)) ∧
    (∀ i j k : Fin t,
      ∀ m : FormalGlueing.piece (f i) (T.F.M i),
      T.F.cocycleLeft i j k (LocalizedModule.mk (LocalizedModule.mk m 1) 1) =
        T.F.cocycleRight i j k (LocalizedModule.mk (LocalizedModule.mk m 1) 1))
